The Perth Bears are the newest NRL expansion team, currently finalizing their roster and branding ahead of their 2027 debut, marking the first time a WA team has competed at the elite level.

The Bright Side:
The growth of local leagues from five to nine teams shows a genuine, organic increase in participation and interest that predates the professional franchise.
